detect magic.name: Detect Magic
detect magic.short: Detects spells and magic items within 60 ft.
detect magic.description: You detect magical auras. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you study a particular area. 1st round: Presence or absence of magical auras. 2nd round: Number of auras and the strength of the strongest aura. 3rd round: Strength and location of each aura.

read magic.name: Read Magic
read magic.description: By means of read magic, you can decipher magical inscriptions on objects—books, scrolls, weapons, and the like—that would otherwise be unintelligible. You can read at the rate of one page (250 words) per minute.

ray of frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray of frost.description: A ray of freezing air and ice projects from your pointing finger. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to deal damage to a target. The ray deals 1d3 points of cold damage.

acid splash.name: Acid Splash
acid splash.description: You fire a small orb of acid at the target. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to hit your target. The orb deals 1d3 points of acid damage.

daze.name: Daze
daze.area: One humanoid creature of 4 HD or less
daze.short: Humanoid creature of 4 HD or less loses next action.
daze.description: This enchantment clouds the mind of a humanoid creature with 4 or fewer Hit Dice so that it takes no actions. Humanoids of 5 or more HD are not affected. A dazed subject is not stunned, so attackers get no special advantage against it.

flare.name: Flare
flare.short: Dazzles one creature (-1 on attack rolls).
flare.description: This cantrip creates a burst of light. If you cause the light to burst directly in front of a single creature, that creature is dazzled for 1 minute unless it makes a successful Fortitude save. Sightless creatures and creatures already dazzled are not affected.

ghost sound.name: Ghost Sound
ghost sound.description: Ghost sound allows you to create a volume of sound that rises, recedes, approaches, or remains at a fixed place. You choose what type of sound ghost sound creates when casting it and cannot thereafter change the sound's basic character.

light.name: Light
light.description: This spell causes a touched object to glow like a torch, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for an additional 20 feet) from the point you touch.

mage hand.name: Mage Hand
mage hand.area: One nonmagical, unattended object weighing up to 5 lb.
mage hand.description: You point your finger at an object and can lift it and move it at will from a distance. As a move action, you can propel the object as far as 15 feet in any direction, though the spell ends if the distance between you and the object ever exceeds the spell's range.

prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
prestidigitation.description: Prestidigitations are minor tricks that novice spellcasters use for practice. Once cast, a prestidigitation spell enables you to perform simple magical effects for 1 hour. The effects are minor: soil, chill, warm, flavor, color, or clean items; lift 1 pound; create dim light; make small objects; and so on.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.description: You imbue the subject with magical energy that protects it from harm, granting it a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws.

magic missile.name: Magic Missile
magic missile.area: Up to five creatures, no two of which can be more than 15 ft. apart
magic missile.short: 1d4+1 damage; +1 missile per two levels above 1st (max 5).
magic missile.description: A missile of magical energy darts forth from your fingertip and strikes its target, dealing 1d4+1 points of force damage. The missile strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee combat or has less than total cover or total concealment.

burning hands.name: Burning Hands
burning hands.description: A cone of searing flame shoots from your fingertips. Any creature in the area of the flames takes 1d4 points of fire damage per caster level (maximum 5d4). Flammable materials burn if the flames touch them.

shield.name: Shield
shield.short: +4 shield bonus to AC; blocks magic missiles.
shield.description: Shield creates an invisible, tower shield-sized mobile disk of force that hovers in front of you. It negates magic missile attacks directed at you. The disk also provides a +4 shield bonus to AC.

mage armor.name: Mage Armor
mage armor.description: An invisible but tangible field of force surrounds the subject of a mage armor spell, providing a +4 armor bonus to AC. Unlike mundane armor, mage armor entails no armor check penalty or arcane spell failure chance.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.area: One or more living creatures within a 10-ft.-radius burst
sleep.short: Puts 4 HD of creatures into magical slumber.
sleep.description: A sleep spell causes a magical slumber to come upon 4 Hit Dice of creatures. Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first. Among creatures with equal HD, those who are closest to the spell's point of origin are affected first. HD that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted.

charm person.name: Charm Person
charm person.description: This charm makes a humanoid creature regard you as its trusted friend and ally (treat the target's attitude as friendly). If the creature is currently being threatened or attacked by you or your allies, however, it receives a +5 bonus on its saving throw.

identify.name: Identify
identify.description: The spell determines the single most basic function of a magic item, including how to activate that function (if appropriate), and how many charges are left (if any).

true strike.name: True Strike
true strike.description: You gain temporary, crystal-clear insight into the immediate future during your next attack. Your next single attack roll (if it is made before the end of the next round) gains a +20 insight bonus. Additionally, you are not affected by the miss chance that applies to attackers trying to strike a concealed target.

shocking grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking grasp.description: Your successful melee touch attack deals 1d6 points of electricity damage per caster level (maximum 5d6). When delivering the jolt, you gain a +3 bonus on attack rolls if the opponent is wearing metal armor (or made of metal, carrying metal, and so forth).

ray of enfeeblement.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
ray of enfeeblement.short: Ray deals 1d6+1 per two levels Str damage.
ray of enfeeblement.description: A coruscating ray springs from your hand. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to strike a target. The subject takes a penalty to Strength equal to 1d6+1 per two caster levels (maximum 1d6+5). The subject's Strength score cannot drop below 1.

color spray.name: Color Spray
color spray.short: Knocks unconscious, blinds, and/or stuns weak creatures.
color spray.description: A vivid cone of clashing colors springs from your hand. Each creature in the area is affected based on its HD: 2 HD or less — unconscious for 2d4 rounds, then blinded for 1d4 rounds, then stunned for 1 round. 3–4 HD — blinded for 1d4 rounds, stunned for 1 round. 5+ HD — stunned for 1 round.

detect secret doors.name: Detect Secret Doors
detect secret doors.description: You can detect secret doors, compartments, caches, and so forth. Only passages, doors, or openings that have been specifically constructed to escape detection are detected by this spell.

scorching ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching ray.short: Ranged touch attack deals 4d6 fire damage, +1 ray/4 levels (max 3).
scorching ray.description: You blast your enemies with fiery rays. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of three rays at 11th level). Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 4d6 points of fire damage.

web.name: Web
web.description: Web creates a many-layered mass of strong, sticky strands. Creatures caught in a web become grappled by the sticky fibers. A Reflex save allows a creature to avoid being trapped. Breaking free requires a Strength or Escape Artist check (DC = spell DC).

mirror image.name: Mirror Image
mirror image.short: Creates decoy duplicates of you (1d4+1 per three levels, max 8).
mirror image.description: Several illusory duplicates of you pop into being, making it difficult for enemies to know which target to attack. The figments stay near you and disappear when struck. Attackers randomly attack one of the images or you, each with equal chance.

blur.name: Blur
blur.short: Attacks miss subject 20% of the time.
blur.description: The subject's outline appears blurred, shifting and wavering. This distortion grants the subject concealment (20% miss chance). A see invisibility spell does not counteract the blur effect, but a true seeing spell does.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.short: Subject is invisible for 1 min./level or until it attacks.
invisibility.description: The creature or object touched becomes invisible, vanishing from sight. If the recipient is a creature carrying gear, that vanishes, too. Items dropped or put down become visible; items picked up disappear if tucked into the clothing or pouches. The spell ends if the subject attacks.

glitterdust.name: Glitterdust
glitterdust.description: A cloud of golden particles covers everything in the area, blinding creatures and outlining invisible things. Any creature in the area must make a Will save or be blinded for the duration. All creatures and objects in the area are outlined in the golden dust (as if under faerie fire).

see invisibility.name: See Invisibility
see invisibility.description: You can see any objects or beings that are invisible within your range of vision, as well as any that are ethereal. Such creatures are visible to you as translucent shapes.

melf's acid arrow.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
melf's acid arrow.short: Ranged touch attack; 2d4 acid/round for 1 round +1/3 levels.
melf's acid arrow.description: A magical arrow of acid springs from your hand and speeds to its target. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to hit your target. The arrow deals 2d4 points of acid damage with no splash damage. For every three caster levels you possess, the acid lasts for another round (to a maximum of 2 rounds at 3rd level, 3 rounds at 6th, etc.)

bull's strength.name: Bull's Strength
bull's strength.short: Subject gains +4 to Str for 1 min./level.
bull's strength.description: The subject becomes stronger. The spell grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength, adding the usual benefits to melee attack rolls, melee damage rolls, and other uses of the Strength modifier.

false life.name: False Life
false life.description: You harness the power of unlife to grant yourself a limited ability to avoid death. While this spell is in effect, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1d10 + 1 per caster level (maximum +10).

create water.name: Create Water
create water.description: This spell generates wholesome, drinkable water, just like clean rain water. Water can be created in an area as small as will actually contain the liquid, or in an area three times as large—possibly creating a downpour or filling many small receptacles. This water disappears after 1 day if not consumed.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.short: +1 on one attack roll, saving throw, or skill check.
guidance.description: This spell imbues the subject with a touch of divine guidance. The subject gets a +1 competence bonus on a single attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. It must choose to use the bonus before making the roll to which it applies.

virtue.name: Virtue
virtue.description: With a touch, you infuse a creature with a small surge of life, granting the subject 1 temporary hit point.

cure light wounds.name: Cure Light Wounds
cure light wounds.description: When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 1d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +5). Since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell deals damage to them instead of curing their wounds.

bless.name: Bless
bless.area: The caster and all allies within a 50-ft. burst
bless.short: +1 on attack rolls and Will saves vs. fear.
bless.description: Bless fills your allies with courage. Each ally gains a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and on saving throws against fear effects.

shield of faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield of faith.short: Aura grants +2 or higher deflection bonus to AC.
shield of faith.description: This spell creates a shimmering, magical field around the touched creature that averts and deflects attacks. The spell grants the subject a +2 deflection bonus to AC, with an additional +1 to the bonus for every six levels you have (maximum +5 deflection bonus at 18th level).

divine favor.name: Divine Favor
divine favor.short: +1 per three levels on attack and damage rolls (min +1).
divine favor.description: Calling upon the strength and wisdom of a deity, you gain a +1 luck bonus per three caster levels (at least +1) on attack and weapon damage rolls for 1 minute. The bonus doesn't apply to spell damage.

command.name: Command
command.short: One subject obeys one-word command for 1 round.
command.description: You give the subject a single command, which it obeys to the best of its ability at its earliest opportunity. You may select from the following options: Approach, Drop, Fall, Flee, Halt.

protection from evil.name: Protection from Evil
protection from evil.short: +2 to AC and saves, counter mind control, hedge out elementals and outsiders.
protection from evil.description: This spell wards a creature from attacks by evil creatures, from mental control, and from summoned creatures. It creates a magical barrier around the subject at a distance of 1 foot. The barrier moves with the subject and has three major effects.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.short: Opponents can't attack you, and you can't attack.
sanctuary.description: Any opponent attempting to strike or otherwise directly attack the warded creature, even with a targeted spell, must attempt a Will save. If the save succeeds, the opponent can attack normally and is unaffected by that casting of the spell.

inflict light wounds.name: Inflict Light Wounds
inflict light wounds.description: When you touch a living creature, you channel negative energy that deals 1d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +5). Since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell cures such a creature of a like amount of damage, rather than harming it.

cure moderate wounds.name: Cure Moderate Wounds
cure moderate wounds.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10).

hold person.name: Hold Person
hold person.description: The subject becomes paralyzed and freezes in place. It is aware and breathes normally but cannot take any actions, even speech. Each round on its turn, the subject may attempt a new saving throw to end the effect (this is a full-round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity).

aid.name: Aid
aid.short: +1 to attack, +1 save vs. fear, 1d8 temporary hp +1/level (max +10).
aid.description: Aid grants the target a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saves against fear effects, plus temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +10).

spiritual weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual weapon.short: Magic weapon attacks on its own.
spiritual weapon.description: A weapon made of pure force springs into existence and attacks opponents at a distance, as you direct it. The weapon takes the shape of a weapon favored by your deity or a force weapon (your choice). It deals 1d8 force damage (+ 1 point per three caster levels, max +5) on a hit.

owl's wisdom.name: Owl's Wisdom
owl's wisdom.short: Subject gains +4 to Wis for 1 min./level.
owl's wisdom.description: The transmuted creature becomes wiser. The spell grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Wisdom, adding the usual benefits to Wisdom-based skills.

silence.name: Silence
silence.area: 20-ft.-radius emanation centered on a creature, object, or point in space
silence.description: Upon the casting of this spell, complete silence prevails in the affected area. All sound is stopped: Conversation is impossible, spells with verbal components cannot be cast, and no noise whatsoever issues from, enters, or passes through the area.

delay poison.name: Delay Poison
delay poison.short: Stops poison from harming subject for 1 hour/level.
delay poison.description: The subject becomes temporarily immune to poison. Any poison in its system or any poison to which it is exposed during the spell's duration does not affect the subject until the spell's duration has expired.

bear's endurance.name: Bear's Endurance
bear's endurance.description: The affected creature gains greater vitality and stamina. The spell grants the subject a +4 enhancement bonus to Constitution, which adds the usual benefits to hit points, Fortitude saves, and so forth.

cure serious wounds.name: Cure Serious Wounds
cure serious wounds.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 3d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +15).

prayer.name: Prayer
prayer.area: All allies and foes within a 40-ft.-radius burst
prayer.short: +1 on most rolls for allies, -1 for foes.
prayer.description: You bring special favor upon yourself and your allies while bringing disfavor to your enemies. You and each of your allies gain a +1 luck bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, saves, and skill checks, while each of your foes takes a -1 penalty on such rolls.

searing light.name: Searing Light
searing light.short: Ray deals 1d8/two levels, more against undead.
searing light.description: Focusing divine power like a ray of the sun, you project a blast of light from your open palm. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to strike your target. A creature struck takes 1d8 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d8). An undead creature takes 1d6 points of damage per caster level (max 10d6).

dispel magic.name: Dispel Magic
dispel magic.description: You can use dispel magic to end ongoing spells that have been cast on a creature or object, to temporarily suppress the magical abilities of a magic item, or to counter another spellcaster's spell. Dispel check: 1d20 + your caster level (max +10) vs. DC 11 + the spell's caster level.

remove curse.name: Remove Curse
remove curse.short: Frees object or person from curse.
remove curse.description: Remove curse instantaneously removes all curses on an object or a creature. Remove curse does not remove the curse from a cursed shield, weapon, or suit of armor, although the spell temporarily suppresses the curse for 1d4 minutes.

remove disease.name: Remove Disease
remove disease.description: Remove disease can cure all diseases from which the subject is suffering. You must make a caster level check (1d20 + caster level) against the DC of each disease affecting the target. Success means that the disease is cured.

magic vestment.name: Magic Vestment
magic vestment.short: +1 enhancement/four levels (max +5) to armor or shield.
magic vestment.description: You imbue a suit of armor or a shield with an enhancement bonus of +1 per four caster levels (maximum +5 at 20th level).

bestow curse.name: Bestow Curse
bestow curse.short: –6 to an ability score; –4 on attacks, saves, and checks; or 50% chance of losing each action.
bestow curse.description: You place a curse on the subject. Choose one of the following three effects: –6 decrease to an ability score (minimum 1); –4 penalty on attack rolls, saves, ability checks, and skill checks; or each turn, the target has a 50% chance to act normally, otherwise it takes no action.

mending.name: Mending
mending.area: One object of up to 1 lb.
mending.short: Repairs minor breaks or tears in objects.
mending.description: Mending repairs small breaks or tears in objects (but not warps, such as might be caused by a warp wood spell). The spell functions on objects of up to 1 pound.

message.name: Message
message.description: You can whisper messages and receive whispered replies. Those nearby can hear these messages with a DC 25 Listen check. You point your finger at each creature you want to receive the message. When you whisper, the whispered message is audible to all targeted creatures within range.

hideous laughter.name: Hideous Laughter
hideous laughter.description: This spell afflicts the subject with uncontrollable laughter. It collapses with helpless laughter for 1 round/level. The subject can take no actions while laughing, but is not considered helpless.

hypnotism.name: Hypnotism
hypnotism.area: Several living creatures, no two of which may be more than 30 ft. apart
hypnotism.description: Your gestures and droning incantation fascinate nearby creatures, causing them to stop and stare blankly at you. In addition, you can use their rapt attention to make your requests seem very reasonable.

silent image.name: Silent Image
silent image.area: Image, up to four 10-ft. cubes + one 10-ft. cube/level (S)
silent image.short: Creates minor illusion of your design.
silent image.description: This spell creates the visual illusion of an object, creature, or force, as visualized by you. The illusion does not create sound, smell, texture, or temperature.

expeditious retreat.name: Expeditious Retreat
expeditious retreat.description: This spell increases your base land speed by 30 feet. This counts as an enhancement bonus. There is no effect on other modes of movement, such as burrow, climb, fly, or swim.

remove fear.name: Remove Fear
remove fear.area: One creature plus one additional creature per four levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
remove fear.short: Suppresses fear or gives +4 on saves against fear for 10 minutes.
remove fear.description: You instill courage in the subject, granting it a +4 morale bonus against fear effects for 10 minutes. If the subject is under the influence of a fear effect when receiving the spell, that effect is suppressed for the duration.

feather fall.name: Feather Fall
feather fall.area: One Medium or smaller free-falling object or creature/level, no two of which may be more than 20 ft. apart
feather fall.description: The affected creatures or objects fall slowly. Feather fall instantly changes the rate at which the targets fall to a mere 60 feet per round (equivalent to the end of a fall from a few feet), and the subjects take no damage upon landing.

heroism.name: Heroism
heroism.short: +2 on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks.
heroism.description: This powerful enchantment imbues a single creature with great bravado and skill. The subject gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks.

suggestion.name: Suggestion
suggestion.short: Compels subject to follow stated course of action.
suggestion.description: You influence the actions of the target creature by suggesting a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two). The activity must seem reasonable.

cat's grace.name: Cat's Grace
cat's grace.short: Subject gains +4 to Dex for 1 min./level.
cat's grace.description: The affected creature becomes more graceful, agile, and coordinated. The spell grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Dexterity.

eagle's splendor.name: Eagle's Splendor
eagle's splendor.short: Subject gains +4 to Cha for 1 min./level.
eagle's splendor.description: The transmuted creature becomes more poised, articulate, and personally forceful. The spell grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma.

know direction.name: Know Direction
know direction.description: You instantly know the direction of north from your current location. This is accurate to 45 degrees.

purify food and drink.name: Purify Food and Drink
purify food and drink.area: 1 cu. ft./level of contaminated food and water
purify food and drink.short: Purifies 1 cu. ft./level of food or water.
purify food and drink.description: This spell makes spoiled, rotten, diseased, poisonous, or otherwise contaminated food and water pure and suitable for eating and drinking.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Grasses, weeds, bushes, and even trees wrap, twist, and entwine about creatures in the area or those that enter the area, holding them fast. Any creature in the area when the spell is cast must make a Reflex save or be entangled.

produce flame.name: Produce Flame
produce flame.description: Flames as bright as a torch appear in your open hand. The flames harm neither you nor your equipment. In addition to providing illumination, the flames can be hurled or used to touch enemies. Using the flames in these ways ends the spell. Each attack deals 1d6 points of fire damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +5).

longstrider.name: Longstrider
longstrider.description: This spell gives you a +10 foot enhancement bonus to your base speed. It has no effect on other modes of movement, such as burrow, climb, fly, or swim.

enthrall.name: Enthrall
enthrall.description: If you have the attention of a group of creatures, you can use this spell to hold them spellbound. To cast the spell, you must speak or sing without interruption for 1 full round.

obscuring mist.name: Obscuring Mist
obscuring mist.levelStr: Air 1, Clr 1, Drd 1, Sor/Wiz 1, Water 1, Weather 1
obscuring mist.area: Cloud spreads in 20-ft. radius from you, 20 ft. high
obscuring mist.description: A misty vapor arises around you. It is stationary. The vapor obscures all sight, including darkvision, beyond 5 feet. A creature 5 feet away has concealment (20% miss chance). Creatures farther away have total concealment (50% miss chance).

faerie fire.name: Faerie Fire
faerie fire.area: Creatures and objects within a 5-ft.-radius burst
faerie fire.short: Outlines subjects with light, canceling blur, concealment, and the like.
faerie fire.description: A pale glow surrounds and outlines the subjects. Outlined subjects shed light as candles. Outlined creatures do not benefit from the concealment normally provided by darkness, blur, displacement, invisibility, or similar effects.

calm animals.name: Calm Animals
calm animals.area: Animals within 30 ft. of each other
calm animals.description: This spell soothes and quiets animals, rendering them docile and harmless. Only ordinary animals (those with Intelligence scores of 1 or 2) can be affected by this spell.

speak with animals.name: Speak with Animals
speak with animals.description: You can comprehend and communicate with animals. You are able to ask questions of and receive answers from animals, although the spell doesn't make them any more friendly or cooperative than normal.

magic fang.name: Magic Fang
magic fang.short: One natural weapon of subject creature gets +1 on attack and damage rolls.
magic fang.description: Magic fang gives one natural weapon or unarmed strike of the subject a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls. The spell can affect a slam attack, fist, bite, or other natural weapon.

summon nature's ally i.name: Summon Nature's Ally I
summon nature's ally i.short: Calls animal to fight for you.
summon nature's ally i.description: This spell summons a natural creature to serve you. It appears where you designate and acts immediately on your turn. It attacks your opponents to the best of its ability.

comprehend languages.name: Comprehend Languages
comprehend languages.short: You understand all spoken and written languages.
comprehend languages.description: You can understand the spoken words of creatures or read otherwise incomprehensible written messages.

augury.name: Augury
augury.short: Learns whether an action will be good or bad.
augury.description: An augury can tell you whether a particular action will bring good or bad results for you in the immediate future.

undetectable alignment.name: Undetectable Alignment
undetectable alignment.description: An undetectable alignment spell conceals the alignment of an object or a creature from all forms of divination.

magic circle against evil.name: Magic Circle against Evil
magic circle against evil.short: As protection from evil, but 10-ft. radius and 10 min./level.
magic circle against evil.description: This spell functions as protection from evil, except that it affects all creatures within 10 feet of the warded creature.

speak with dead.name: Speak with Dead
speak with dead.short: Corpse answers one question per two caster levels.
speak with dead.description: You grant the semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions.

death ward.name: Death Ward
death ward.short: Grants immunity to death spells and negative energy effects.
death ward.description: The subject is immune to all death spells, magical death effects, energy drain, and negative energy effects.

divination.name: Divination
divination.short: Provides useful advice concerning a proposed course of action.
divination.description: Similar to augury but more powerful, a divination spell can provide useful advice concerning a proposed course of action.

freedom of movement.name: Freedom of Movement
freedom of movement.description: This spell enables you or an ally to move and attack normally despite magical and nonmagical impediments.

sending.name: Sending
sending.short: Delivers short message anywhere, instant reply.
sending.description: You contact a particular creature and can send a short message of twenty-five words or less.

commune.name: Commune
commune.short: Deity answers yes-or-no questions, one per round.
commune.description: You contact your deity and ask questions that can be answered by a short phrase.

greater command.name: Greater Command
greater command.area: One living creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
greater command.short: As command, but affects one subject/level.
greater command.description: This spell functions like command, except that you may affect one creature per level.

true seeing.name: True Seeing
true seeing.short: Lets you see all things as they actually are.
true seeing.description: You confer on the subject the ability to see all things as they actually are.

greater dispel magic.name: Greater Dispel Magic
greater dispel magic.area: One spellcaster, creature, or object; or 20-ft.-radius burst
greater dispel magic.short: As dispel magic, but +4 bonus on check.
greater dispel magic.description: This spell functions like dispel magic, except that the maximum bonus on the dispel check is +20 instead of +10.

slay living.name: Slay Living
slay living.description: You can slay any one living creature. The target takes 3d6 points of damage + 1 per caster level (max +25).

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: A fireball spell generates a searing explosion of flame that detonates with a low roar and deals 1d6 points of fire damage per caster level (maximum 10d6) to every creature within the area.
